summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The m Nasdaq-100 Accelerator Autocall ETF (MPIA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in income alternatives. The fund is an actively managed ETF designed to pursue high monthly income with reduced downside risk by using swaps to track a diversified, laddered portfolio of approximately 60 synthetic autocallable notes referencing a leveraged, volatility-managed Nasdaq-100 futures index. MPIA was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by m+ Funds.
